items.prompt: Which fact proves common-row sample covariance is PSD?

options.text: Every diagonal is nonnegative, with no other checks

options.why: The squared norm is nonnegative when n>=2.

options.text: The source data are automatically Gaussian
options.why: Gaussianity is unnecessary for this algebraic sample identity.

options.text: There are always more features than observations
options.why: That can instead force rank deficiency.

items.explanation: The common centered-data Gram representation proves nonnegative quadratic forms in every direction.
